name: get_knowledge_entry
title: Get FIRMS documentation entries
description:
Return one or more FIRMS knowledge-base entries by ID, each with FIRMS's text verbatim in `body`, its `source_url`, and its `retrieved` date.

Use it to read the caveat entries listed in get_fire_detections results, to follow the `related` IDs of an entry, or to open an entry found with list_knowledge_topics. Unknown IDs are listed in `not_found` with the closest existing IDs. Entries FIRMS no longer publishes have `status: retired` and a `notice`; say so if you rely on one.

This tool does not need a FIRMS MAP_KEY.
